title: Food & Beverage
summary: Food, beverage and consumer goods makers use PI System for OEE, downtime, weight control, yield and giveaway, fermentation and Clean-In-Place. AF templates per machine let one change cascade to every line, and edge collection serves small sites.
hierarchy:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  C[Company] --> S[Site or Plant]
  S --> L[Production Line]
  L --> M1[Filler]
  L --> M2[FFS Packer]
  L --> M3[Oven]
```

tags.name: Bags per minute
tags.description: Packing rate captured on each FFS machine (Illovo).

tags.name: Machine State
tags.description: Running or stopped state that drives downtime event frames.

tags.name: Downtime Reason
tags.description: Reason code for each downtime event.

tags.name: Weight
tags.description: Product weight by line, used for giveaway tracking (Tyson).

templates.name: OEE Machine
templates.description: Machine template giving OEE broken into availability, performance and quality (Illovo).

calculations.name: OEE
calculations.expression: OEE = Availability x Performance x Quality
calculations.description: Availability = Run time / Planned production time; Performance = (Ideal cycle time x Total count) / Run time; Quality = Good count / Total count. Standard formula.

eventFrames.name: Downtime
eventFrames.trigger: Machine State is not Running, with a reason-code attribute

eventFrames.name: CIP phase
eventFrames.trigger: Clean-In-Place phases: pre-rinse, caustic main wash, final rinse, acid second wash

kpis.name: OEE
kpis.definition: Overall Equipment Effectiveness: availability x performance x quality. Kellogg's Valls reported a best-in-class 80%.

kpis.name: Giveaway
kpis.definition: Product overfilled beyond the declared weight.

kpis.name: Yield
kpis.definition: Saleable output relative to input; Tyson reported a 0.1% improvement.

pitfalls: Relying on shift log sheets gives little reliable machine data (Illovo's starting point).
Do not cite Nestlé (Waverly) or General Mills as PI examples; those AVEVA stories use AVEVA Historian/CONNECT and System Platform, not PI System.
verifyNote: The AF hierarchy is inferred, and the OEE formula details are the standard definitions rather than from a PI source. Food-safety regulation (FSMA, HACCP CCP logging) in PI deployments was not found.
